title: Explorer entity registry
responsibility: Builds categorized active entities and selected-commit removal entries from revision data.

inputs.name: explorerChange.head
inputs.description: Revision whose first-parent source impact is inspected.

inputs.name: explorerChange.unit
inputs.description: Unit identifier to classify as changed.

inputs.name: explorerEntity.head
inputs.description: Revision providing verdict and change context.

inputs.name: explorerEntity.unit
inputs.description: Unit to convert to an explorer entity.

inputs.name: explorerEntities.head
inputs.description: Shown revision with registry and source impact.

inputs.name: explorerEntities.parent
inputs.description: Optional first-parent revision, used to show removed units in their last active form.

inputs.name: explorerEntity.includePrivate
inputs.description: Explicitly resolve a private callable for an owner or retained detail address; defaults to false for collections.

outputs.name: explorerChange
outputs.description: First matching impact mark in added, direct, indirect, removed order, or null without a match.

outputs.name: explorerEntity
outputs.description: Named entity with category, role, purpose, source unit, verdict, change and app route; null for an uncategorized unit.

outputs.name: explorerEntities
outputs.description: Active head entities grouped in category order, plus units explicitly removed by head and active in the supplied parent but no longer active in head. Removed entries retain their parent contract and receive a removed/not-proven verdict.
